title: Grand-Builder
description: A visual Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that lets you build large structures with animated placement, previews, speed control, pause, rollback, and custom structure saving.
body:
# Grand Builder

**Grand Builder** is a visual Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that makes building large structures from schematics and custom templates easier and more impressive.

The mod keeps the main “wow effect” of animated structure building, while making the mechanic practical for normal gameplay, survival worlds, and servers.

## Main features

- Animated construction of large structures
- Preview before starting the build
- Confirmation before launching construction
- Construction speed switching
- Pause and resume at any moment
- Safe rollback of the last build
- Saving custom structures
- Support for external structure files
- Works in singleplayer and on dedicated servers

## Supported formats

Grand Builder can work with structures in the following formats:

- `.nbt`
- `.schem`
- `.schematic`

## What the mod is for

Grand Builder is useful for players who want to place large builds in a more visual and controlled way instead of instantly pasting them into the world.

It is suitable for creative building, survival projects, server events, map making, and testing large structures before placing them permanently.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.11
- Mod loader: Fabric
- Environment: Client and server
